newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up on crude, firm Asian markets.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up on crude, firm Asian markets.

text.p: NWE naphtha edged higher on Wednesday in line with higher crude prices and improving naphtha prices in the all-important Asian markets.
Swaps were up with April paper trading at $188.50 cif NWE and talked at $188/$189.50. May was quoted at $189/$190 and June at $188.25/$188.75.
Traders attributed the gains to improving prices in crude. May Brent was trading 27 cents higher at $18.20 a barrel at 1158 GMT.
Firmer naphtha prices in Asia were also seen as supportive. Singapore swaps strengthened for the second day running with May paper quoted at $21.70/$21.90 from $2.55/$21.65 on Tuesday.
Traders said physical action was fairly muted with most end-users well covered. -- London Newsroom, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
